reason: S1 changes the default ancillary CRC policy to SPNG_CRC_DISCARD and adds rollback state handling for discarded text and sPLT chunks, but H0 unconditionally calls spng_set_crc_action(ctx, SPNG_CRC_USE, SPNG_CRC_USE). That override prevents fuzz inputs from exercising the new default ancillary-discard behavior and its undo paths. This material configuration and state-coverage gap is introduced by the S0-to-S1 change.
evidence: spng_ctx_new2 now initializes ctx->crc_action_critical to SPNG_CRC_ERROR and ctx->crc_action_ancillary to SPNG_CRC_DISCARD.
The spng_crc_action documentation now identifies SPNG_CRC_DISCARD as the default for ancillary chunks.
read_non_idat_chunks now assigns undo = text_undo for text chunks and undo = splt_undo for sPLT chunks, then invokes undo(ctx) when discard is set.
H0 always invokes spng_set_crc_action(ctx, SPNG_CRC_USE, SPNG_CRC_USE), overriding the new ancillary default before parsing.
SPNG_CRC_USE is documented as ignoring and not calculating the checksum, so malformed ancillary CRC inputs cannot select the newly relevant CRC-discard rollback behavior under H0.
recommended_action: Add a fuzz-controlled CRC-policy mode that sometimes leaves the spng_ctx_new2 defaults unchanged and sometimes selects explicit policies, while retaining the current SPNG_CRC_USE mode. Include inputs containing text and sPLT chunks with invalid CRCs so read_non_idat_chunks can exercise text_undo and splt_undo.
